Krita brush files used as test fixtures for the importer (src/brushes/import/krita.ts).

small-set.bundle
  A small bundle made by copying seven presets (Basic-5 Size default, Pencil-1 Hard, Basic-6 Details, Pencil-4 Soft,
  Stamp Sparkles, Basic-1, Eraser Circle) and the three brush pictures they use (plain_rake.png, graphite_grain.gih,
  fairy-dust.gih) out of Krita's "Krita_4_Default_Resources.bundle", unchanged, with that bundle's mimetype and meta.xml.
  The bundle's meta.xml names its authors ("Deevad with derivations of the brushes of Ramon Miranda, Razvanc, Radian,
  Wolthera, Storm, Scottyp and other") and its licence as CC-0, the same as the default resources that ship with Krita.

Basic-5_Size_default.kpp
  One preset copied unchanged from the same bundle, so the same CC-0 licence.
